description: MALAI: Get personalised ideas for the user's next meal or snack, chosen by MALAI from their saved recipes and MALAI's GLP-1-friendly recipes to close today's protein gap at this time of day. Use for "what should I eat", "what's for dinner", "I'm hungry", "something light with protein". Returns up to 3 options with protein and calories. To log one, call malai_log_food with the values in its logWith field.
name: malai_suggest_next_meal

meal.description: Meal slot the ideas are for.

logWith.description: Pass these values to malai_log_food to log this suggestion.

title: Next meal ideas
